payment_sumup.api_key.label: API key
payment_sumup.api_key.help: Your own SumUp API key, from the SumUp developer portal. Kept hidden.
payment_sumup.merchant_code.label: Merchant code
payment_sumup.merchant_code.help: Your SumUp merchant code, shown in your SumUp account.
payment_sumup.app_id.label: Affiliate app ID
payment_sumup.app_id.help: The app ID Universal Till's built-in SumUp key was made for. Leave the default unless told otherwise.
payment_sumup.reader_id.label: Card reader ID
payment_sumup.reader_id.help: The SumUp Solo reader paired with this till. Required for card payments: without it a payment is declined (unless Test mode is on).
payment_sumup.currency.label: Card payment currency
payment_sumup.currency.help: The currency SumUp charges in. Automatic uses your shop's currency. A manual choice must match the currency the till sells in, otherwise card payments are declined rather than charged in the wrong currency.
payment_sumup.test_mode.label: Test mode
payment_sumup.test_mode.help: On: no card is charged and nothing is sent to SumUp (amounts ending .13 decline, .99 time out, anything else approves). Off (default): real payments only.
